mapper.sql: select `aw`.`id`, `aw`.`group_id` AS `attendanceGroupId`, `aw`.`staff_id`, `aw`.`date` AS `clockDate`, `aw`.`week`, `aw`.`is_holiday`, `awc`.`id` AS `arrangeClassesId`, `awc`.`name` AS `arrangeClassesName`, `awc`.`start_work_time`, `awc`.`end_work_time`, `awc`.`start_real_time`, `awc`.`end_real_time`, `awc`.`before_start_real_time`, `awc`.`after_start_real_time`, `awc`.`before_end_real_time`, `awc`.`after_end_real_time`, `awc`.`mark`, `cc`.`start_work_clock_time`, `cc`.`start_work_clock_status`, `cc`.`end_work_clock_time`, `cc`.`end_work_clock_status`, `apc`.`id` AS `apcId`, `apc`.`way`, `apc`.`address`, `apc`.`latitude`, `apc`.`longitude`, `apc`.`effective_range`, `apc`.`wifi`, `apc`.`mac`, `apc`.`device_name`, `apc`.`device_model`, `apc`.`device_code`, `apc`.`device_genre` from `arrange_work` aw LEFT JOIN `arrange_work_classes` awc ON aw.`arrange_work_classes_ids` LIKE CONCAT('%',awc.`id`,'%') LEFT JOIN `attendance_group` ag ON aw.`group_id` = ag.`id` LEFT JOIN `attendance_group_punch_card_way` apc ON ag.`id` = apc.`group_id` LEFT JOIN `classes_clock` cc ON aw.`staff_id` = cc.`user_id` AND awc.`id` = cc.`arrange_classes_id` where 1 = 1
mapper.select: SELECT s.`id`, s.`user_id`, s.`name`, s.`mobile`, CONCAT( awc.`name`,'（', IF ( aw.`date` < #{date} and awc.`end_time_is_morrow`, CONCAT( '昨日', awc.`start_work_time` ), awc.`start_work_time` ), '-', IF ( aw.`date` = #{date} and awc.`end_time_is_morrow`, CONCAT( '次日', awc.`end_work_time` ), awc.`end_work_time` ) , '）' ) AS `className`, IF ( s.`state` = 'ON_DUTY', 1, 0 ) AS `onDuty` FROM `arrange_work` aw LEFT JOIN `arrange_work_classes` awc ON aw.`arrange_work_classes_ids` LIKE CONCAT( '%', awc.`id` , '%' ) LEFT JOIN `attendance_group` g ON aw.`group_id` = g.`id` LEFT JOIN `cube-srv-gen-personnel-management`.staff s ON aw.`staff_id` = s.`id` WHERE g.`classes_type` = 'ARRANGE' AND s.`state` IN ( 'ON_DUTY', 'OFF_DUTY', '' ) AND ( awc.`start_real_time` >= #{beginOfDay} AND awc.`start_real_time` <= #{endOfDay} OR awc.`end_real_time` >= #{beginOfDay} AND awc.`start_real_time` <= #{endOfDay} ) ORDER BY `onDuty` DESC

SELECT awc.`id` FROM `arrange_work_classes` awc LEFT JOIN `arrange_work` aw ON aw.`arrange_work_classes_ids` LIKE CONCAT( '%', awc.`id` , '%' ) WHERE awc.`end_real_time` < #{dateTime} AND aw.`id` IS NULL

SELECT aw.`staff_id` as `id`, aw.`tenant` FROM `arrange_work` aw LEFT JOIN `arrange_work_classes` awc ON aw.`arrange_work_classes_ids` LIKE CONCAT( '%', awc.`id` , '%' ) WHERE aw.`date` = #{date} AND aw.`arrange_work_classes_ids` = ''
